source.title: Aramaic Incantation Bowls Project
source.citation: Loyola Marymount University Archaeology Center. “Aramaic Incantation Bowls Project.” Accessed 4 September 2026.
source.notes: The museum project page states that four terracotta bowls are under conservation, translation, high-resolution imaging, and 3D documentation, but does not publish accession numbers or item-level records.

summary: One of four distinct terracotta incantation bowls documented as part of Loyola Marymount University's conservation and translation project.
